description: The scheme-level settings of an ora.context-scheme.v2 scheme: the shared services' parameters.

unit.description: The unit the age stages count in; the summaries and the lossless invariants count ActionSteps.

exact_tail.description: The exact tail: what no summary absorbs, in exact_tail_unit (completed ActionSteps when it is absent).

exact_tail_unit.description: The unit the exact tail counts in; absent: action_step. exchange: the latest exact_tail exchanges plus the latest robot action's exchange (its call, its receipt and the observation after it), however old.

reserve_tokens.description: Tokens kept free beside the maximum output: hard input limit = window - max output - reserve.

image_tokens.description: Tokens the request estimate charges per inline image before a Provider report anchors it.

references.description: Whether and how recoverable references are shown (services/references.ts).

pointers.description: Pointers are shown; summary slots name their exact transcript.

advertise_over_bytes.description: A tool result larger than this advertises its Pointer at first delivery; null: never.

head_bytes.description: The first bytes an externalized result keeps as its preview.
